formulations.Polymer system Notes: Low-MW PEO (Aldrich), Mn = 3.9-4.5 kDa, Mw/Mn = 1.02-1.21, purified by precipitation in petroleum ether from 5% THF solutions and dried under high vacuum for 48 h. A control with high-MW PEO (Mn = 300 kDa, Mw/Mn = 4) with LiTFSI at EO/Li = 8 and 128 gave conductivity data (50-110 °C) that superimposed on the low-MW data.
formulations.Notes: Mixtures made under a dry atmosphere by mixing 1-5% methanol solutions of each component; solvent evaporated in ampules on a vacuum system. Conductivity measured on bulk amorphous (supercooled) electrolytes in stainless steel/Teflon cells by impedance (5 Hz-13 MHz).
formulations.Reference: Lascaud, S.; Perrier, M.; Vallée, A.; Besner, S.; Prud'homme, J.; Armand, M. Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Behavior of Poly(ethylene oxide)-Molten Salt Rubbery Electrolytes. Macromolecules 1994, 27, 7469-7477.
